mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical norms compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 90.0 for 3 months), production bottlenecks reduce corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0 for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market, reducing household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 600.0 for 3 months), increased construction and consumer spending boost economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0 for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
